quote:
1. This is the first form to be used in site selection. This form will also enable 
identification of true of mangroves of the area, native associates, invasive etc. 
Data should be used in deciding the best combination of plants that should be 
introduced during restoration. Avoid invasives and species not seen in the area 
in healthy mangrove patches.
interpretation: Source recommends avoiding invasive and locally unobserved species when choosing planting composition. Species-selection implementation guidance; not exclusion of the restoration site.

quote:
2. Nomenclature to be used (A = area identified for restoration, B= periphery of 
the area identified for restoration, C= if the periphery does not contain a natural 
mangrove ecosystem, the nearest mangrove patch) 
3. In each strata, lay belt transects of 1m width and varying lengths (10 to 50m). 
Ideally at least 10% of the area should be covered by belt transects and they 
should be laid to represent the area.
interpretation: Target/periphery/nearest-reference strata and survey coverage; no forest-proximity cutoff or minimum suitable area.

interpretation: Water pH, water salinity, water temperature, soil salinity, soil temperature, aerobic-layer depth and number of soil cores. Water pH is not soil_pH; water/soil temperature is not mean annual air temperature; aerobic-layer depth is not soil depth to bedrock.

quote:
How to use this form: 
1.Take at least 3 measurements per strata to determine the mean value of above parameters.  
2.Ideal if these measurements could be repeated over dry and wet seasons. 
3.Use a soil auger to take soil samples. 
4.Soil samples should be duly frozen and should be analysed by an entity with expertise.  
5.Method of approved analysis is as follows:
interpretation: At least three measurements, wet/dry-season repetition and laboratory handling are measurement protocol. No approved method follows this line before Form4 on PDF173; visually verified.
Checklist requests soil pH while Form3 places pH under Water. Source inconsistency retained, not resolved by relabelling.
Example cumulative R.apiculata counts; not an observed restoration trial or survival rate.
